purpose: Separate embedded Doom compile/link composite combining native ESP32-P4 USB gamepad input with the existing audited Doom SFX seam; no Mac relay and no authorized runtime hardware path.
runtime_blockers: Three independent flash-resident volatile app-source gates are immutable zeroes, so app_main returns before display, USB Host, GPIO30, I2S, or any other hardware initialization while preserving the complete guarded graph in the link; no Kconfig toggle can enable them.
The reusable USB host component's independent fixture authorization is false, and its fallback evidence is invalid by construction.
J16 reaches the native ESP32-P4 HS data pair but cannot source protected controller VBUS; no reviewed powered, current-limited, backfeed-isolated direct-data fixture is bound.

The current platform_audio direct-I2S backend is only a compile/link seam, not the final sound path: connected-unit amplifier-family population/isolation is unproven and optional direct and expected U4 outputs can converge on J4/J6.
The linked backend uses a 20 ms post-enable settle, which conflicts with the latest review's at-least-350 ms zero-data U4 startup requirement.

A future speaker runtime requires a codec-only backend/refactor after the expected ES8311 path is proven, or physical proof that a direct NS4168 path is populated and isolated, followed by a new exact runtime authorization.
This app is absent from the central flash/readback/single-launch allowlist and has not been flashed or hardware-tested.
No formal reproducible-build evidence record has been added; the current local canonical build is a compile/link result only.
The WAD-bearing local firmware artifact is not authorized for redistribution.
